raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer falsely reported that Wikipedia stated Waylon Jennings was buried in Chandler, Arizona at “Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery,” conflating the place of death with the place of burial and introducing an unverified cemetery. This contradicted earlier verified information from Find a Grave showing City of Mesa Cemetery (Mesa, Arizona) and lacked direct citation or on-page evidence, leading the process toward an incorrect burial location.
